subject.title: feat(discord/voice): add sessionChannelId to autoJoin for text-channel transcript routing

question: Should Discord voice text mirroring be implemented by extending the existing `voice.agentSession` target surface, by adding per-autoJoin `sessionChannelId`, or by reopening the broader voice-as-I/O design?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent config surface changes public Discord voice behavior and overlaps an already-shipped `voice.agentSession` route.

options.title: Extend `voice.agentSession`
options.body: Use the existing voice-level target route as the canonical session selector and add explicit text transcript/reply mirroring semantics there if maintainers want visible Discord text output.

options.title: Accept per-autoJoin target
options.body: Review or replace the linked fork PR around `autoJoin.sessionChannelId`, including same-guild validation, delivery semantics, docs, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Reopen broader bridge design
options.body: Treat this narrow issue as a satellite and first settle speaker attribution, target selection, and tool-access policy in the broader Discord voice-as-I/O design.

recommendation.title: Extend `voice.agentSession`
recommendation.body: Use the existing voice-level target route as the canonical session selector and add explicit text transcript/reply mirroring semantics there if maintainers want visible Discord text output.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history on Discord realtime voice routing and already reviewed this issue’s config/delivery boundary.
